summary.business_type: SaaS (B2B automated-response platform) with 9 industry-vertical landing pages, targeting small businesses in Serbia
top_findings: stomatolozi.html, the pilot/lead vertical page, is now the thinnest and least-developed of the 9 niches, missing sections its siblings have.
Content-Security-Policy ships Report-Only with no violation collector, so it provides zero enforced protection and can't safely graduate to enforced.
Render-blocking Google Fonts + local CSS delay first paint by ~1.4s even though hero content is already server-rendered.
No trust/authority signals anywhere: no About page, no PIB/registration number, no testimonials, zero backlinks, zero external brand mentions.
quick_wins: Update public/sitemap.xml lastmod values for the 11 pages changed on 2026-09-05 (all still show 2026-08-27)
Add a CSP report-to/report-uri collector so the Report-Only policy can eventually be enforced
Add a 301 redirect from extensionless URLs to the canonical .html form
Self-host Fraunces/Inter fonts instead of loading from fonts.googleapis.com
Re-export the 9 niche hero JPEGs as WebP/AVIF at correct dimensions

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Build-time prerendering confirmed live via curl -- every route serves complete HTML, not an empty CSR shell
robots.txt/sitemap.xml valid and correctly cross-referenced
Unique canonical, title, and meta description on every page
Full security header baseline live: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
HTTPS enforced site-wide, single-hop redirects, correct 404 handling with noindex

findings.title: CSP ships Report-Only with no violation collector
findings.description: content-security-policy-report-only has no report-to/report-uri directive, so violations are only visible in individual visitors' DevTools consoles -- nobody on the team ever sees them, meaning the policy can never safely graduate to enforced. 'unsafe-inline' on script-src/style-src remains a gap even once enforced.
findings.recommendation: Add a report-to/report-uri endpoint (Netlify Function or a free Sentry/Report URI collector). Once a deploy cycle passes with no unexpected violations, promote to enforced Content-Security-Policy. Plan to remove 'unsafe-inline' by externalizing the inline chat-widget-loader script.

findings.title: Extensionless URLs duplicate canonical .html pages
findings.description: Netlify's pretty-URL rewriting serves /stomatolozi and /stomatolozi.html both as 200 with identical content, and Netlify's own case/trailing-slash redirects point to the extensionless form -- contradicting the canonical tag, which points to the .html form.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit Netlify redirect forcing the extensionless form to 301 to the .html form for every route.

findings.title: No IndexNow key/endpoint configured
findings.description: No IndexNow key file at the site root and no reference in robots.txt.
findings.recommendation: Generate an IndexNow key, publish it as a static file, and ping the IndexNow API on content changes.

findings.title: Google Fonts stylesheet is render-blocking with no fallback-metrics matching
findings.description: The Fraunces/Inter stylesheet is a blocking <link rel="stylesheet"> with display=swap but no size-adjust/ascent-override fallback metrics -- a plausible CLS contributor at the hero.
findings.recommendation: Add font fallback-metric overrides once field/lab CLS data confirms a shift near text load.

findings.title: No Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy / Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy headers
findings.description: Minor additional isolation hardening missing alongside the otherwise solid security header set.
findings.recommendation: Add COOP: same-origin and CORP: same-site, testing the cross-origin chat widget still functions.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 9 vertical pages are genuinely differentiated: distinct problem statements, capability lists, demo transcripts, and FAQ content matching FAQPage schema 1:1
Core '62% of missed calls' statistic is disclosed honestly with source, year, sample size, and an explicit non-equivalence caveat for Serbia
Readability is good: short sentences, concrete second-person scenarios, plain language
llms.txt exists, accurate, and in sync with the niches data file

findings.title: No About/company page and no visible entity trust signals
findings.description: Only a personal Gmail address and mobile number appear in Header/Contact. No founder identity, headcount, client logos, testimonials, or third-party recognition anywhere on the site.
findings.recommendation: Add an About/Company page or expand sta-radimo.html with founder identity and the company's registration details and address.

findings.title: No company registration number (PIB/maticni broj) disclosed
findings.description: Absent from every page and both legal documents reviewed -- a standard trust checkpoint for a commercial Serbian service.
findings.recommendation: Add PIB/MB to the footer and/or legal pages.

findings.title: 'How it works' 3-step explainer is identical across all 10 pages
findings.description: Confirmed byte-for-byte identical text across stomatolozi.html, veterinari.html, and advokati.html -- the one remaining significant duplicate block on the site.
findings.recommendation: Localize at least the three step bodies per vertical.

findings.title: sta-radimo.html is thin relative to its role
findings.description: 196 rendered words -- a bulleted restatement of services already listed in the homepage schema, with no depth on mechanism, onboarding, SLAs, or data retention.
findings.recommendation: Expand with genuine mechanism/SLA/data-handling detail.

findings.title: stomatolozi.html is now the thinnest of the 9 verticals
findings.description: 622 rendered words vs. 781-869 for the other 8, a 4-item capability list vs. 6-7 for siblings, and missing the proof block entirely.
findings.recommendation: Bring stomatolozi's capability list and content depth up to parity with the other 8 niches.

findings.title: Core statistic remains a decade-old, small non-Serbian sample
findings.description: The '62%' stat is well-disclosed but still a 2016, 85-company U.S. sample -- an AI answer engine paraphrasing the page could drop the disclaimer and mis-cite it as Serbian data.
findings.recommendation: Keep the current honest disclosure; replace with Serbia/Balkans-relevant or first-party client data once available.

findings.title: FAQPage schema present and matching visible content sitewide
findings.description: A genuine improvement over the prior audit. Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites in May 2026.
findings.recommendation: Keep the schema -- it's harmless and correctly matches content -- but don't expect a SERP rich-result or confirmed AI-citation benefit.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique, well-sized titles and meta descriptions across all 15 templates
Clear H1 per page
Consistent, flat internal linking structure (one hop from home to every vertical)

findings.title: No question-phrased H2/H3 headings anywhere
findings.description: Every section heading is a declarative statement rather than a question form, limiting how AI retrieval systems are believed to segment pages into answerable chunks.
findings.recommendation: Convert section titles into question-style H2s where it reads naturally (e.g. 'Kako APLORY radi?').

findings.title: No dated content or authorship signals anywhere
findings.description: No datePublished/dateModified in JSON-LD, no visible 'last updated' text, and sitemap.xml's static lastmod doesn't help since it's hand-set, not build-generated.
findings.recommendation: Add datePublished/dateModified to JSON-LD and/or a visible 'poslednje azurirano' line; generate sitemap lastmod at build/deploy time.

findings.title: Duplicated 'How it works' section drags on-page uniqueness
findings.description: Cross-referenced with Content Quality -- the one remaining significant duplicate block across all 10 pages.
findings.recommendation: See Content Quality recommendation.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: All 20 JSON-LD blocks across 11 pages parse as valid JSON with no syntax errors
No deprecated types present anywhere
FAQPage visible content matches JSON-LD Question/Answer text 1:1 on every page that has it
Schema ships pre-rendered, consistent with the site's build-time SSR
No placeholder text, all absolute HTTPS URLs

findings.title: ProfessionalService/LocalBusiness is a type mismatch for a remote SaaS product
findings.description: APLORY has no storefront or physical service area; its openingHoursSpecification (00:00-23:59 every day) really means 'the software runs continuously,' not 'our premises are staffed.' This risks Google surfacing APLORY as a literal local business for an entity that has neither an address nor hours.
findings.recommendation: Model APLORY as an Organization that provider's a Service, not a LocalBusiness subtype. Skip SoftwareApplication too -- it needs app-store-style properties that don't fit a subscription service. Drop openingHoursSpecification entirely.

findings.title: provider object duplicated inline across 10 pages instead of @id reference
findings.description: Each vertical page repeats a full inline provider object instead of referencing a stable @id -- a maintenance risk since any edit to phone/email/name requires 11 changes instead of one.
findings.recommendation: Add an @id to the homepage Organization entity and replace every vertical page's inline provider with an @id reference.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList anywhere on the site
findings.description: The site has a clear home -> vertical-page hierarchy that isn't declared in structured data.
findings.recommendation: Add a BreadcrumbList to each vertical page reflecting Home -> [Vertical name]. Low priority for a flat, one-hop site.

findings.title: FAQPage present, valid, matches visible content -- no SERP benefit
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites in May 2026 -- no SERP feature this markup can currently produce.
findings.recommendation: Leave existing FAQPage blocks in place; don't invest further effort chasing a SERP benefit that doesn't exist.

findings.title: Homepage entity still missing image/sameAs/address
findings.description: Already identified in the repo's own SCHEMA-REPORT.md and generated-schema.json but never applied to the live index.html.
findings.recommendation: Roll into the Organization migration above; add logo, image, and sameAs using only real, currently-live profile URLs.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: LCP 1.6-1.7s (Good) on both pages tested, lab data -- hero H1 is the LCP element and is already server-rendered
CLS 0.03-0.07 (Good), TBT 20-30ms (Good)
TTFB excellent: 176-278ms
Chat widget is already correctly deferred to first interaction, not blocking initial load
JS bundle quality is clean -- no unminified code, no unnecessary polyfills

findings.title: Render-blocking Google Fonts + local CSS delay first paint by ~1.4s
findings.description: The hero H1 text is present in the server-rendered HTML and could paint at TTFB (~200ms) but the browser is held at blank/partial paint for ~1.4s while it fetches and parses render-blocking CSS/font requests first.
findings.recommendation: Self-host Fraunces/Inter as woff2 instead of fonts.googleapis.com, preload font files, and inline critical above-the-fold CSS. Expected impact: LCP down to ~0.3-0.5s.

findings.title: Chat widget fires a burst of main-thread work concurrent with the user's first interaction
findings.description: The ~188KB LeadConnector widget is correctly deferred to first scroll/mousemove/touchstart/keydown, but that means its cost now lands exactly when the user starts reading/scrolling -- a likely source of slow field INP invisible to lab tools.
findings.recommendation: Change the trigger to a lazier signal (longer idle delay or scroll-depth gate) and evaluate whether the bundled 44KB libphonenumber-js is needed for the phone field.

findings.title: Niche hero photos are oversized JPEGs in a legacy format
findings.description: All 9 niche hero photos ship as full-resolution baseline JPEGs 1.3-3.3x larger than display size; one (auto-servisi.jpg) is 452KB with 67% identified as wasted bytes on the equivalent measured image.
findings.recommendation: Re-export all nine as WebP/AVIF at correct dimensions via the Vite asset pipeline; expect 60-80% size reduction.

findings.title: Footer logo is 2x oversized for its display size
findings.description: logo-mark.webp is 12.6KB with 11.3KB estimated wasted -- already WebP, purely a sizing/compression issue.
findings.recommendation: Re-export at 2x actual display size with higher compression; expect drop to 1-3KB.

findings.title: Fonts served from external origin adds an extra cross-origin hop
findings.description: 4 separate fonts.gstatic.com woff2 files totaling ~202KB, fetched only after the fonts.googleapis.com CSS resolves -- a secondary contributor to the render-blocking chain.
findings.recommendation: Same fix as the render-blocking finding -- self-host the fonts, removing the external dependency chain outright.

findings.title: Speed Index and Time to Interactive trail LCP well behind
findings.description: Homepage Speed Index 5.9s vs. LCP 1.6s; stomatolozi Speed Index 5.7s vs. LCP 1.7s. Not a failing CWV today but limited margin as more content is added.
findings.recommendation: Fixing the render-blocking and oversized-image findings will pull Speed Index down as a side effect.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Prerendering fix confirmed live -- full content crawlable without JS execution, resolving the prior audit's #1 GEO blocker
llms.txt exists and is accurate
FAQPage JSON-LD matches visible content sitewide
robots.txt cleanly allows all AI crawlers via wildcard

findings.title: No self-contained passages in the 134-167-word optimal AI citation length
findings.description: FAQ answers run 16-36 words by design -- terse UI copy, not citable standalone paragraphs. The '62%' stat is presented as headline + sentence + footnote-style source, not a single citable sentence.
findings.recommendation: Add 1-2 expanded 134-167-word paragraphs per page/niche where it matters most -- the legal-compliance FAQ answer and/or a fully-attributed version of the core statistic.

findings.title: Zero external brand/entity signals
findings.description: No sameAs links, no Wikipedia entity, no YouTube/Reddit/LinkedIn footprint -- a long-horizon problem that cannot be shortcut by markup or copy changes.
findings.recommendation: Begin building external presence over time: a demo video, a LinkedIn company page, encouraging early customer mentions. Cannot be accelerated by code changes alone.

findings.title: No question-phrased H2/H3 headings
findings.description: Every section heading is declarative rather than question-form, which may limit how AI retrieval systems segment the page.
findings.recommendation: Convert at least some section titles to question form where it reads naturally.

findings.title: No visible dates or authorship signals
findings.description: No datePublished/dateModified anywhere, and sitemap lastmod is static, not build-generated.
findings.recommendation: Add dated/authorship signals; generate sitemap lastmod automatically.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All images carry explicit width/height attributes (good CLS hygiene)
Appropriate loading=eager usage for above-the-fold hero images

findings.title: 8 of 9 niche hero photos are oversized legacy-format JPEGs
findings.description: None are WebP/AVIF; one runs at 452KB with 67% of an equivalent image's bytes identified as waste relative to its actual display size.
findings.recommendation: Re-export all as WebP/AVIF at correct dimensions -- see Performance section for full detail.

findings.title: Footer logo is 2x oversized
findings.description: Already WebP but sized for 2x its display dimensions.
findings.recommendation: Re-export at correct 2x display size with higher compression.

findings.title: No responsive image sets (picture/srcset) in use
findings.description: Every image ships one fixed size regardless of viewport.
findings.recommendation: Consider a srcset/picture approach for the niche hero photos once re-exported in modern formats.
